title: Bitcoin/Litecoin and EVM explorers, Telegram public-channel watch (batch p2-G09-2)
owner: batch p2-G09-2 (P211 btc_explorers, P212 evm_explorers, P357 telegram_channel_watch)

attributes.total_sent: total amount sent by a wallet over its history (exact decimal string with unit)
attributes.balance_base_units: exact wallet balance in the chain's smallest unit as a decimal string (satoshis, litoshis, koinu, duffs or wei)
attributes.explorer_failover: sequential explorer failover of one address: {answered_by, order, per_provider [{provider, source, status, reason, elapsed_s, sent}], disclosed_to, elapsed_s, over_budget, budget_s}
attributes.disclosed_to: public explorers/providers that received the investigated value in this run (OPSEC: they saw the lookup); empty when only a self-hosted instance answered
attributes.data_freshness: how current an explorer answer is: {provider, provider_tip_height, latest_tx_height, blocks_since_latest_tx, fetched_at, from_cache}
attributes.activity_window: first/last on-chain activity seen: {first_seen, last_seen, first_seen_exact (true only when every transaction was read or the provider gives it), txs_examined}
attributes.is_contract: bool: the EVM address holds contract code (eth_getCode != '0x'), false for an externally owned account
attributes.ens_name: ENS name of an Ethereum address as reported by the explorer (reverse record), or the ENS name a typed name.eth resolved from
attributes.top_token_holdings: top token holdings of an EVM wallet by fiat value: list of {symbol, name, token_address, amount, fiat_value, type}; unpriced (often airdropped spam) tokens rank last
attributes.stop_node_hint: explorer label class that should stop automatic graph expansion (P213): 'exchange' | 'mixer'
attributes.telegram_watch_alerts: new matches of org-profile watch rules in public Telegram channel posts: list of {key, channel, post_id, date, url, rule_id, rule_kind, provenance (team_list | deepdarkcti), excerpt (<= 200 chars of scrubbed text)}
attributes.telegram_watch_digest: deduplicated one-line digest of the new Telegram watch alerts (date, t.me/channel/post, provenance, rule, excerpt)
attributes.telegram_watch_cycle: bookkeeping of one Telegram watch cycle: {cycle, channels_planned, channels_read, pages_read, posts_new, could_not_read, paused, rate_limited, backoff_until, team_list_problems, deepdarkcti}
attributes.news_watch_hits: headline-only matches of org-profile watch rules in a news RSS companion feed: list of {title, link, published, rule_id, source}

relations.contract_creator: contract address -> address that deployed it (creator; a lead for scam-token deployers, never expanded automatically)
relations.ens_resolves_to: ENS name -> Ethereum address its record resolves to (as reported by the explorer at lookup time; records can change)
